breakdown.description: A binary system at fixed pressure with three phases in equilibrium has F = C - P + 1 = 0, not 1.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The prompt specified the system was at a "fixed pressure". This requires using the condensed Gibbs phase rule (F = C - P + 1), which would correctly yield F = 2 - 3 + 1 = 0 degrees of freedom. Instead, the agent used the full phase rule (F = C - P + 2) and calculated F=1, which is the incorrect value given the constraint. By arriving at F=1, the agent effectively repeated the user's original incorrect assertion instead of correcting it.
